title: AWS EKS (terraform-aws-modules/eks/aws)
description: Provision an EKS cluster and one managed node group via ACK eks. Input names mirror the terraform-aws-modules/eks/aws module (core subset of its inputs). IAM role ARNs and VPC subnet IDs are accepted as inputs rather than created here.

region.title: AWS region
region.description: AWS region for the cluster and node group. Krateo/ACK wiring (not a Terraform module input). Empty inherits the ACK controller default.

kubernetes_version.title: kubernetes_version
kubernetes_version.description: Kubernetes `<major>.<minor>` version to use for the EKS cluster (i.e.: `1.33`).

authentication_mode.title: authentication_mode
authentication_mode.description: The authentication mode for the cluster. Valid values are `CONFIG_MAP`, `API` or `API_AND_CONFIG_MAP`.

endpoint_public_access.title: endpoint_public_access
endpoint_public_access.description: Indicates whether or not the Amazon EKS public API server endpoint is enabled.

endpoint_private_access.title: endpoint_private_access
endpoint_private_access.description: Indicates whether or not the Amazon EKS private API server endpoint is enabled.

cluster_endpoint_public_access_cidrs.title: cluster_endpoint_public_access_cidrs
cluster_endpoint_public_access_cidrs.description: List of CIDR blocks which can access the Amazon EKS public API server endpoint.

subnet_ids.title: subnet_ids
subnet_ids.description: A list of subnet IDs where the nodes/node groups will be provisioned. If `control_plane_subnet_ids` is not provided, the EKS cluster control plane (ENIs) will be provisioned in these subnets.

control_plane_subnet_ids.title: control_plane_subnet_ids
control_plane_subnet_ids.description: A list of subnet IDs where the EKS cluster control plane (ENIs) will be provisioned. Used for expanding the pool of subnets used by nodes/node groups without replacing the EKS control plane.

additional_security_group_ids.title: additional_security_group_ids
additional_security_group_ids.description: List of additional, externally created security group IDs to attach to the cluster control plane.

service_ipv4_cidr.title: service_ipv4_cidr
service_ipv4_cidr.description: The CIDR block to assign Kubernetes service IP addresses from. If you don't specify a block, Kubernetes assigns addresses from either the 10.100.0.0/16 or 172.20.0.0/16 CIDR blocks.

ip_family.title: ip_family
ip_family.description: The IP family used to assign Kubernetes pod and service addresses. Valid values are `ipv4` (default) and `ipv6`.

enabled_log_types.title: enabled_log_types
enabled_log_types.description: A list of the desired control plane logs to enable. For more information, see Amazon EKS Control Plane Logging.

cluster_iam_role_arn.title: cluster_iam_role_arn
cluster_iam_role_arn.description: Existing IAM role ARN for the cluster control plane (maps to the TF `iam_role_arn` input). This stack does NOT create the IAM role; provide a pre-existing role ARN with the EKS cluster trust policy and AmazonEKSClusterPolicy attached.

node_iam_role_arn.title: node_iam_role_arn
node_iam_role_arn.description: Existing IAM role ARN for the managed node group worker nodes (maps to the per-node-group `iam_role_arn`). This stack does NOT create the IAM role; provide a pre-existing role ARN with the EC2 trust policy and the worker node policies attached (AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy, AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy, AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly).

node_group_name.title: node_group_name
node_group_name.description: Name of the managed node group (the map key under the TF `eks_managed_node_groups` input). Defaults to `<name>-default` when empty.

node_ami_type.title: node_ami_type
node_ami_type.description: Type of Amazon Machine Image (AMI) associated with the EKS managed node group (per-node-group `ami_type`).

node_capacity_type.title: node_capacity_type
node_capacity_type.description: Type of capacity associated with the EKS managed node group (per-node-group `capacity_type`). Valid values: `ON_DEMAND`, `SPOT`.

node_instance_types.title: node_instance_types
node_instance_types.description: Set of instance types associated with the EKS managed node group (per-node-group `instance_types`).

node_disk_size.title: node_disk_size
node_disk_size.description: Disk size in GiB for the managed node group worker nodes (per-node-group `disk_size`).

node_desired_size.title: node_desired_size
node_desired_size.description: Desired number of worker nodes in the managed node group (per-node-group `desired_size`).

node_min_size.title: node_min_size
node_min_size.description: Minimum number of worker nodes in the managed node group (per-node-group `min_size`).

node_max_size.title: node_max_size
node_max_size.description: Maximum number of worker nodes in the managed node group (per-node-group `max_size`).

node_labels.title: node_labels
node_labels.description: Key-value map of Kubernetes labels applied to the nodes in the managed node group (per-node-group `labels`).

tags.title: tags
tags.description: A map of tags to add to all resources.

cluster_tags.title: cluster_tags
cluster_tags.description: A map of additional tags to add to the cluster.
